ei.title: Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life
ei.subject: 영어1

fullPassage:
Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.

questions.passage: Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its (A)[uniqueness / similarity] often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully (B)[blends / separates] two (C)[distinct / identical] Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong. Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ uniqueness–blends–distinct: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① uniqueness–separates–distinct: separates(분리)는 blends(혼합)의 반의어
❌ ② similarity–blends–distinct: similarity(유사성)는 uniqueness(독특함)의 반의어
❌ ④ uniqueness–blends–identical: identical(동일한)은 distinct(뚜렷한)의 반의어

questions.passage: Living in the sanseong was not practical due to (A)[scarce / abundant] farmland and (B)[poor / excellent] living conditions though. So during (C)[peaceful / turbulent] times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① scarce–poor–peaceful: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ② abundant(풍부한)는 scarce의 반의어
❌ ③ excellent(우수한)는 poor의 반의어
❌ ④ turbulent(격동의)는 peaceful의 반의어
det.tip: scarce ↔ abundant / poor ↔ excellent / peaceful ↔ turbulent

questions.passage: Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety. After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that (A)[combined / separated] the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the (B)[natural / artificial] slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed (C)[strong / weak] walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ combined–strong–natural: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① separated(분리된)는 combined의 반의어
❌ ② weak(약한)는 strong의 반의어
❌ ③ artificial(인공의)는 natural의 반의어
det.tip: combined ↔ separated / strong ↔ weak / natural ↔ artificial

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 역할을 했다. 활용(utilizing) vs 무시(ignoring). 높은. 효과적으로.
det.analysis:
✅ ① served: 최후 방어 역할 — 적절
❌ ② ignoring: 원문 utilizing. 산악 지형 활용 맥락에서 무시는 부적절 ←정답
✅ ③ higher: 고지대 — 적절
✅ ④ effectively: 효과적 방어 — 적절
det.tip: utilizing(활용) ↔ ignoring(무시). 산악 지형을 이점으로 활용.

det.korean: 수용(housed). 학습(learning). 일반(Common). 후퇴(withdrew) vs 전진(advanced).
det.analysis:
✅ ① housed: 건물 수용 — 적절
✅ ② learning: 학습 센터 — 적절
✅ ③ Common: 일반 백성 — 적절
❌ ④ advanced: 원문 withdrew. 전쟁 시 안전한 곳으로 피신 맥락에서 전진은 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: withdrew(물러남) ↔ advanced(전진). 전쟁 시 산성으로 피신.

det.korean: 등장(emerged) vs 사라짐(vanished). 결합. 보여줌. 역할.
det.analysis:
❌ ① vanished: 원문 emerged. 새 성곽 등장 맥락에서 사라짐은 부적절 ←정답
✅ ② combined: 장점 결합 — 적절
✅ ③ displayed: 방어력 표출 — 적절
✅ ④ serving: 중심지 역할 — 적절
det.tip: emerged(등장) ↔ vanished(사라짐). 새 유형 성곽 탄생 맥락.
